He continued smashing the bottle down, each blow nearly cracking Ba Zhennan's skull.

"Let them come here. You take him back and tell Xu Chun, if you want to fight, then fight. Stop talking nonsense and get out of here with this piece of trash!" Huang Meng kicked the man several times, even breaking his nose in his rage.

It's said that this was orchestrated by the Huang family patriarch, concentrating all resources to deal with the aggressive Southwest Chamber of Commerce. As for Zhao An, he's just a minor target, one of the points of contention in the conflict. He's an innocent bystander caught in the crossfire, only Zhao An has a big reputation and is considered a neutral resource. So what if he's a collateral branch of the Bai family? Even if he were a direct descendant, they'd still be crushed.

*Slap! Slap! Slap!* A round of applause rang out, and Zhao An entered with two slender white female bodyguards. They were dressed casually, mostly in shorts and a casual shirt, with a pair of oddly chosen casual shoes. If they were wearing flip-flops, they would basically look like nouveau riche landlords with several properties.
Ba Zhennan flew into a rage, walking over and glaring fiercely at Huang Meng. "Say that again if you dare!"
After becoming a eunuch, he would lose interest in women, allowing him to focus more on his career, finding ways to improve himself and create more wealth.

While greeting guests, Huang Meng pondered how to plead with Zhao An. He had a bold idea, but he needed a bit of help first. As for the consequences, he didn't care. Eunuchs were generally long-lived; he was only thirty, with a bright future ahead of him. If he remained healthy, he could live at least another forty or fifty years. He needed to make a name for himself.

Huang Meng was seething with rage, but outwardly remained calm. "Yeah, I'm down on my luck now, worse than a dog. What do you want? Come to the party if you want. I'll remember everyone who comes today. Heh, what I've lost, I'll get back sooner or later. Ba Zhennan, don't be so smug, you're just Xu Chun's dog."

Unique natural advantages, coupled with a unique geographical location, allowed for the cultivation of many plants. With each family united, they essentially monopolized the industries of the Southwest region.
Huang Meng's expression remained unchanged. "Brother Zhennan, I am very pleased to welcome you."

"I said you're a dog!" Huang Meng suddenly grabbed a wine bottle and smashed it over Ba Zhennan's head, knocking him to the ground. "I said you're a dog! Who the hell do you think you are! Talking to me like that! If you want to fight the Huang family, come at me, you son of a bitch!"

These bodyguards had never witnessed such a scene. Ba Zhennan had done similar things before, when they were the perpetrators. Now they were the victims, and naturally, they were at a loss. They could only carry Ba Zhennan away hastily to find Xu Chun and their superiors to take responsibility.

Seeing the seductive aura emanating from his wife, Fang Shuiling, a kind of charm she had never possessed before, he realized that the woman's allure had blossomed after being slept with so much, making her appear incredibly seductive. Yet, she possessed an air of dignified elegance, driving one to a frenzy, an irresistible urge to pin her down and ravage her.

"That was truly spectacular! It's been a long time since I've seen such a performance. Impressive, impressive! Looks like you're still got it. Tsk tsk tsk, not bad, a man of spirit." Zhao An clapped his hands, his smile radiant, a smile that would make anyone feel good.

chapters.title: Chapter 1027 A man who attracts attention
paragraphs: The appearance of Zhao An elicited gasps of surprise from those present. It was even more intriguing than the earlier farce, because Zhao An was practically a elusive figure, rarely seen, and reportedly seldom attended school, yet consistently scored close to 100 on exams, with the school turning a blind eye to his performance. After all, Zhao An's donations allowed the school to expand and purchase better educational equipment. How could they teach when their students were already earning money? It was all just a matter of passing the time and getting a diploma. It was said that Fudan University, Cambridge, and Ivy League universities had all extended offers to him; if he wished, he could immediately become a student at these world-renowned institutions.

However, Zhao An refused. He preferred this freedom to working part-time. Studying? He knew everything. His current research area was beyond the reach of many scientists—the ultimate energy conversion, quantum mechanics, magnetic field mechanics, and so on—knowledge that even university professors might not understand. For him, school was purely a pastime, and his success made him a prominent figure.

"These are Australian steaks; the hotel has prepared a lot. Someone, tell the kitchen to make a lot more for Young Master An to enjoy. Remember, make sure it's delicious! Go!" Huang Meng ordered, sending his men to run the errand. His strategist, Gong Xin, was also there to keep him company. Since there was nothing else to do, attending a party wasn't a bad idea.

"It's alright. It's just a financial crisis. It happened two months ago. You think buying stocks and funds is that simple? Heh, I didn't make much, just over three billion. That stuff is really boring, the money comes too fast. Soros, some financial tycoon? Just trash. This kind of money-making method is not as good as doing some real business. Stocks are just for making quick money, like a game of musical chairs!" Zhao An scoffed, taking out a cigarette, lighting it, exhaling a smoke ring, his expression utterly contemptuous. He certainly had the right to say that, based on his achievements.

These words caused everyone around to gasp. Over three billion yuan—what does that mean? At least those attending this party weren't particularly wealthy. And assets and capital are different; the former includes fixed assets like real estate. The latter is real cash on hand. Three billion yuan is three billion yuan—real money!
"Is this Zhao An? He's so dashing, clearly a talented individual."

Zhao An's arrival undoubtedly heated up the party atmosphere. Zhao An is a cash cow; receiving his guidance or even a potential collaboration would be extremely beneficial for the wealthy businessmen present. Especially now that the financial crisis has hit, and industries are clearly sluggish, new ventures are needed to generate even more profit.
"What a handsome man! I wonder if we'll have a chance to sleep together tonight?"
"He really knows how to eat! What a strong man!"
"Is this how a genius eats?"
Women like my cousins only know that Zhao An is incredibly wealthy—enough money he could never spend even if he stopped running his company and lived a life of extravagance.

Huang Meng tossed aside his wine bottle, plastered a bright smile, and walked over, shaking Zhao An's hand. "Young Master An, it's an honor to have you here. It's a pleasure to meet you. Please come in, Young Master An. I've prepared some fine wine and steak; please try them."

Such outstanding individuals are rare these days, and Zhao An's wealth has never been publicly disclosed or listed; no one knows exactly how much money he has. Only his closest women know, and without exception, all of these women are pregnant and nearing their due dates.

Undeniably, in the stock and futures market, it's possible to profit if you want to. Some people have the idea but lack the capital. Some have the capital but lack the idea, but those who succeed all have both. It's simple: buy low and sell high, using various methods to inflate the value of stocks and futures, then sell them off to reap the profits from unsuspecting investors.
"Indeed, I hear he has several projects under his belt; even a small portion of that would be enough for us to live a life of luxury."

Zhao An and Huang Meng were bitter rivals. They had never actually fought, their results generally even. However, it was clear to everyone that Huang Meng had lost. A young master from a wealthy family fighting a commoner to a standstill—it was practically a case of "good-for-nothing" written all over his face. Someone born with a silver spoon in his mouth couldn't beat his opponent; what else could he be but a good-for-nothing? "Just here for fun, don't take it too seriously." Zhao An picked up a glass of red wine and began devouring the steaks on the table without any hesitation. These steaks were all high-quality, cooked to perfection—not rare or medium-well, but well-done—and the taste was superb. What's the point of eating medium-well if it's contaminated with bacteria? Is it just for showing off?

One of the middle-aged businessmen's eyes darted back and forth, glancing between his wife and Zhao An. He knew Zhao An's interests. It was practically common knowledge that Zhao An had numerous ambiguous rumors about his relationships with women, though none had been confirmed. What was undeniable was that Zhao An was indeed attracted to women, whether young babes or mature women; as long as they were exceptionally beautiful, he could easily seduce them.
"US dollars?" Huang Meng asked tentatively.
"As expected of Young Master An, so bold and generous!"
Wow, one sentence and he dismissed a financial tycoon.

Zhao An ate his steak while drinking, without any restraint. Such a carefree eating style would be seen as uncultured, uncultured, and lacking in manners by a poor young man! But with him, everyone around him praised him.

"Is Young Master An satisfied? He seems to be in a good mood lately. I lost quite a bit of money during the financial crisis." Huang Meng said obsequiously. For a direct descendant of one of the four great families to be pouring wine for Zhao An with such a humble tone was simply shameful!

"Nonsense, otherwise who would play with you? If it's not US dollars, is it Japanese yen? Or Vietnamese dong?" Zhao An sneered. "This financial crisis is no ordinary one. I think at least tens of billions have been wiped out in the stock market. The global chain reaction means it won't recover for at least a year. After a year is another story. It could be a year or more if things go well, or three to five years if things go slowly. Hehe, this is really fun, interesting, very interesting, fucking interesting."

chapters.title: Chapter 1028 New energy?
paragraphs: A collective gasp filled the air. Over three billion US dollars? Damn, and he's spouting such flippant nonsense! This is utterly pretentious! Is he trying to kill us all?
The men couldn't help but feel a pang of envy, but mostly admiration. Is this what young people are like? A top student is a top student; they can make money on anything, and make a fortune!

"Want to learn? I'll teach you. But I don't have time now. We'll talk about it later. After you've eaten and drunk your fill, let's go find some fun." Zhao An yawned, watching the fashion shows on TV, observing them closely.

On the other side, a glass box sat on the table, containing a windmill-like device with seawater underneath, connected to pipes. During operation, seawater enters the conduit and, after being converted by a device, becomes hydrogen energy to power the neon lights.
"Hmph, how could I possibly leave the family?" Lin Mei'e clearly knew this, so she muttered under her breath. The Lin family was powerful, and leaving the family was unrealistic.

"Ladies and gentlemen, this is a new invention by Mr. An, the boss of Future Group. As for its exact purpose, I don't know. It's just for your reference, to bring a little surprise to Young Master Meng's party. Feel free to come and take a look. Mr. An is very busy and doesn't have time to meet you all, so he's presented this to you. If you have any questions, please contact me, and I will pass them on to Young Master Meng. Young Master Meng will mention you to Mr. An when he has time," Gong Xin explained from the side. His words were quite direct: if they wanted to meet Zhao An, they should talk to him; if they offered a satisfactory price, he would introduce them to Zhao An.

The women, their beautiful eyes gleaming, whether married or single, felt a surge of arousal. Faced with Zhao An's overwhelming charisma, he had them completely under his thumb, utterly powerless to resist. This is what men are like!

Lin Yuanyuan, however, stopped them, saying, "Enough, let's go back and sit down. This is probably Zhao An's idea. Humph, you stinky man." She meant that Zhao An's actions were heartless; after having a physical relationship, he only got a treatment plan for leukemia drugs, and now there was no further cooperation, which was closely related to the previous problems.
Then, a brief demonstration was given, which piqued the interest of many. It was clearly a demonstration of machinery and energy, proving what Zhao An had been working on recently.
Now, this demonstration seemed to prove Zhao An's research results; even if it wasn't successful, it was close enough.
"Young Master An, how did you make your money?" Huang Meng had to ask respectfully. He wanted to learn too; this kind of thing wasn't something everyone could handle.

Bai Qiuqin and the others wanted to follow into the private room, but Huang Meng stopped them, saying, "Ladies, today isn't your day. I have things to arrange for Young Master An. If you want to talk to Young Master An about anything, you can do it later. Hehe, we're all so familiar with each other, don't make me lose my temper."

"We're all in the same boat." Bai Qiuqin retorted in kind, scoffing. The three women sat in a corner smoking, not discussing anything, but deep in thought. Zhao An currently had a significant advantage; how could they possibly give up everything to follow him and become his mistresses? Besides, they still held positions of power within the family and managed the company.
"Yes, that lecherous man had the same conditions." Lin Mei'e snorted, glancing at Bai Qiuqin. "Don't you have a husband? Are you planning to do something unfaithful?"

"Okay." Zhao An simply nodded to Lin Yuanyuan and Bai Qiuqin in the corner, not approaching them. Although these women had slept with him, they still needed training. He'd leave them for later. When the profits were big enough, they would come begging to him, stripping naked, abandoning all dignity, and working like bitches to please him.
The entire glass box is quite simple; it's just a resource-based power generation system, nothing special.
Aside from powerful families, very few people could do it.

Energy! This was undoubtedly the hottest industry of the new century, but developing new energy sources was incredibly difficult. Without a significant amount of time, it was impossible to develop them within a few years. In addition, it required massive amounts of capital for experimentation and wasting money. These were things that ordinary people couldn't do; it was a bottomless pit. The profits might not be huge, but the initial investment was billions upon billions, all calculated in US dollars.

As for any potential gains, there were no guarantees, only an opportunity. It was a matter of willingness; one could remain indifferent or try to make the connection. Even obtaining a postcard from someone like Zhao An could lead to future collaborations.
Zhao An was smoking in the private room when Fang Shuiling followed him in. As Huang Meng's nominal wife, she was responsible for entertaining him.

Even the four women sitting in the corner gasped. Good heavens, he casually made more money in the stock market than they could in a long, long time. It would take them at least five or ten years, if not a year. Their profits certainly wouldn't reach one hundred million US dollars a year, and those businesses weren't even their responsibility!
Now everyone knew that to see Zhao An, they'd have to go to Huang Meng. Otherwise, even if they met, they wouldn't be able to strike up a conversation and wouldn't pass the test at all.
"Do you think we'll listen to you? Huang Meng, don't think you're so great." Lin Mei'e snorted, unable to tolerate a eunuch swaggering in front of her.
This caught Bai Qiuqin's attention. Her beautiful eyes narrowed slightly. "You have the same conditions?"
Even a fool knows that new energy is profitable; the key is having no connections. But now, a path was laid out before them—how could this not cause panic!
"Young Master An, how about I arrange for you to meet some businessmen? Chat a bit longer, maybe you'll discover something new." Huang Meng whispered, offering to act as a pimp.

Huang Yu, who was handling the approval process within the family, also received a call. He had been feeling sleepy, but upon hearing this, he was instantly wide awake, especially after seeing the video presentation. A cold sweat inexplicably broke out on his spine. If someone else got their hands on this, it would be a powerful tool for turning their life around. This Zhao An, he thought, was impossible to suppress, wasn't he?

To get Zhao An's help, besides women, other benefits were needed. Furthermore, he needed to get his foolish family head brother to make a major strategic mistake, which he could then salvage. He's already reached an agreement with the Southwest Chamber of Commerce; they'll work together. Four brands are still four brands; as long as one of the other three is taken down, there won't be any problems.
Lin Mei'e nodded, "I understand, Dad."

We'll hold an engagement ceremony for you two in half a month." Lin Dongsheng made the decision without any hesitation.

Remember, if you get pregnant, fight for your own best interests. Don't fight for the family; just focus on being a good wife."

But after being slept with, she was already Zhao An's woman, and her heart belonged to him; she had gradually fallen in love with that despicable man.
